name: SE-gated Residual MLP Encoder
tagline: MLP encoder with squeeze-and-excitation per-layer feature gating, residual + LayerNorm, then per-transition Gaussian projection.

key_hyperparams.name: init_w
key_hyperparams.role: uniform init range for output linear

init_recovers: MLP encoder baseline when SE gate -> 1 and residual is removed
diff_from_baseline: Augments the mlp_encoder baseline with a per-layer Squeeze-Excitation feature gate (sigmoid bottleneck on the post-activation) and adds residual + LayerNorm around each block, while keeping per-transition outputs for product-of-Gaussians aggregation.

name: Cross-attention to Learnable Prototypes
tagline: MLP per-transition embedding + sinusoidal PE, then transitions cross-attend to 4 learnable task prototypes (transformer block).
formula:
$$ h = \mathrm{MLP}(x) + \mathrm{PE}(\text{seq}), \quad P \in \mathbb{R}^{4\times d}\;(\text{learnable}) $$
$$ h \leftarrow \mathrm{LN}\!\big(h + \mathrm{MHA}_{2}(Q\!=\!h, K\!=\!P, V\!=\!P)\big),\;\; h \leftarrow \mathrm{LN}(h + \mathrm{FFN}_{2d}(h)) $$
$$ \text{out}_t = W_o h_t $$
init_recovers: near-MLP baseline when prototypes are zero (cross-attention contributes ~0)
diff_from_baseline: Replaces self-attention or recurrent context with a transformer block whose keys/values are 4 learnable task prototypes, plus sinusoidal positional encoding and a 2x FFN; outputs are still per-transition for PoG.

name: Self-attn + Mean Pool + log(N) Logvar Fix
tagline: Self-attention over context, mean-pool to one summary, broadcast to all transitions, and add log(N) to logvar to undo PoG over-shrinkage.
formula:
$$ h_i = \mathrm{MLP}(x_i),\;\; H = \mathrm{LN}(H + \mathrm{MHA}_4(H,H,H)) $$
$$ \bar h = \tfrac{1}{N}\sum_i h_i,\;\; (\mu, \log\sigma^2) = W_o \bar h $$
$$ \text{out}_i = (\mu,\;\log\sigma^2 + \log N)\quad\forall i $$
init_recovers: attention_encoder baseline when pool is removed
diff_from_baseline: Generalises the attention_encoder by mean-pooling attended features into ONE Gaussian, broadcasting it to N copies, and adding $\log N$ to logvar so PEARL's product-of-Gaussians aggregation does not falsely shrink variance.

name: Reward-FiLM Encoder + Confidence Gate
tagline: Per-transition MLP modulated by FiLM(reward), with reward-magnitude-gated mean and tanh-bounded logvar.
formula:
$$ h = \mathrm{MLP}_2(x), \quad (g, b) = W_{\text{film}}(\tanh r), \quad h \leftarrow h \odot (1 + 0.5\tanh g) + 0.5\tanh b $$
$$ y = W_{\text{out}}(\mathrm{ReLU}(h)) + 0.1\,W_{\text{skip}}(x), \quad c = \sigma(2|r|) $$
$$ (\mu, \log\sigma^2) = (c\cdot y_{:d},\; -5 + 6\,\sigma(y_{d:}) + (1-c)) $$

key_hyperparams.name: confidence
key_hyperparams.role: scales mean and shifts logvar by (1-c)

init_recovers: reward-conditioned MLP without FiLM/confidence when g,b -> 0 and c -> constant
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the plain MLP encoder with a FiLM-modulated MLP that uses the (last-feature) reward to gate features, adds a small linear input skip, and post-hoc rescales mean by a confidence c=σ(2|r|) plus shifts logvar by (1-c) and bounds it to [-5,1].

name: Residual + LayerNorm MLP, Split Mean/Logvar
tagline: MLP with per-layer LayerNorm and residual (with linear projection on dim mismatch); separate heads for mean and logvar (logvar bias 0.5).

key_hyperparams.name: residual_proj
key_hyperparams.value: Linear when in_dim != h_dim, else Identity

init_recovers: mlp_encoder baseline when residual coefficients zero
diff_from_baseline: Compared to the mlp_encoder baseline it adds per-layer LayerNorm, a residual connection (with shape-matching projection), and replaces the single output head with separate linear heads for mean and logvar (logvar bias initialised to 0.5).
